location: external: circuit-clienttest/ench-curses-pack.js with circuit-clienttest/cursepack, a data pack giving binding the main hand's slots, vanishing the head's, protection the binding effect (as {"note": 1}) and unbreaking the vanishing effect (in the official servers' world/datapacks before their first start, and as Circuit's data-pack); Circuit's side also in tests/rules/rules_tests.cpp and tests/server/server_tests.cpp
description: With the curses' slots moved and their effects given to protection and unbreaking, a survival player clicks and uses a plain helmet over a bound helmet and over protection pieces, picks a bound sword up from the main hand, then dies with a vanishing sword, ingot and helmet, unbreaking items, protection leggings and stone: the curses act whatever their slots and on the other enchantments; Circuit and both official servers give identical output
